label: Tornado number
description: A count of tornadoes during the year. Before 2007, numbers were assigned as the information arrived in the NWS database. Since 2007, numbers may have been assigned in sequential (temporal) order after event date/times were converted to CST. Do not use om to count the sequence of tornadoes through the year: late entries and corrections are not re-sequenced. Segments of a tornado that crosses state borders and/or more than 4 counties share the same om (see ns/sn/sg).
notes_from_our_review: In the 2025 file, om is a long string (e.g., 0710162316-01) for some years from 2007 on; read as string. Use yr + om as the tornado ID.

label: Time zone
description: All times, except ?=unknown and 9=GMT, were converted to 3=CST. Account for this when building queries for GMT summaries (e.g., 12z-12z).
notes_from_our_review: The 2025 file also contains a few undocumented codes (0 and 6).

label: State
description: State. PR = Puerto Rico, VI = Virgin Islands.
notes_from_our_review: File also includes AK, HI, DC; filter for CONUS if needed.

label: State FIPS
description: State FIPS number. Some Puerto Rico codes are incorrect.

label: State number
description: Number of this tornado in this state in this year. May not be sequential in some years. Discontinued in 2008; can be recalculated by sorting, after accounting for border-crossing tornadoes and 4+ county segments.

label: (E)F-scale rating
notes_from_our_review: -9 (EF-Unknown) is common from 2016 on. Ratings are damage ratings, not measured intensity.

label: Injuries
description: Injuries. When summing state totals, use sn = 1, not sg = 1.

label: Fatalities
description: Fatalities. When summing state totals, use sn = 1, not sg = 1.

label: Property loss
units_or_codes: Before 1996: category code; from 1996: millions of dollars
description: Estimated property loss. Before 1996, a category code: 0 or blank = unknown; 1 = <$50; 2 = $50-$500; 3 = $500-$5,000; 4 = $5,000-$50,000; 5 = $50,000-$500,000; 6 = $500,000-$5,000,000; 7 = $5,000,000-$50,000,000; 8 = $50,000,000-$500,000,000; 9 = $5,000,000,000. From 1996, property damage in millions of dollars (may change to whole dollars in the future). An entry of 0 does not mean $0. When summing state totals, use sn = 1, not sg = 1.
notes_from_our_review: Units are not comparable before vs. from 1996.

label: Crop loss
description: Estimated crop loss in millions of dollars (started in 2007). An entry of 0 does not mean $0.

label: Path length
notes_from_our_review: Some records have 0 (unphysical); Edwards et al. recommend removing them. Lengths rose after the 2007 EF transition.

label: Path width
notes_from_our_review: Max width from 1995 (mean width before). Some records have 0. Widths rose after the 2007 EF transition.

label: Number of states
description: Number of states affected by this tornado. See segment codes below.

label: State number flag
description: 1 = entire track info in this state.

label: Segment number
description: Tornado segment number. 1 = entire track info. Codes (ns,sn,sg): 1,1,1 = entire record for the track (unless all 4 FIPS codes are non-zero); 1,0,-9 = continuing county FIPS info only, from the 1,1,1 record (same om); 2,0,1 = a two-state tornado (st = state of touchdown, other fields summarize the entire track); 2,1,2 = first or second state segment of a two-state tornado (same om); 2,0,-9 = continuing county FIPS for a 2,1,2 record that exceeds 4 counties (same om); 3,0,1 = a three-state tornado (st = state of touchdown, other fields summarize the entire track); 3,1,2 = first, second, or third state segment of a three-state tornado (same om).
notes_from_our_review: One row per tornado: sg == 1. State totals of counts/casualties: sn == 1. Drop sg == -9 rows when counting.

label: 1st county FIPS
notes_from_our_review: 0 = unknown. Combine with stf for a 5-digit county FIPS.

label: 4th county FIPS
description: 4th county FIPS code. Additional counties are listed in sg = -9 records with the same om.

label: F-scale changed flag
description: Added in 2016. fc = 0 for an unaltered (E)F-scale rating; fc = 1 if the previous rating was -9 (unknown). Applies to 1,864 CONUS tornadoes from 1953-1982 that were re-rated from property loss and path length (spec p. 4).
notes_from_our_review: (In the hail/wind files, field 29 is mt: magnitude type, wind only.)

label: Ending date
notes_from_our_review: Present from 2007 on in the 2025 file.

label: Ending time
notes_from_our_review: Present from 2007 on in the 2025 file.
